scopes.name: admin:sessions:summary:read
scopes.description: Read live playback summaries without diagnostic details or session control.

scopes.name: libraries:read
scopes.description: Discover libraries visible to the account or selected profile, without storage metadata.

scopes.name: admin:users
scopes.description: Manage user accounts: create, list, read, update, and delete users and read their profiles. Cannot create or modify admin accounts.

scopes.name: admin:access-groups:read
scopes.description: Read access groups and their policies.

scopes.name: admin:monitor:read
scopes.description: Monitor the server read-only: live sessions, playback history, activity stats, accounts, devices, downloads, node and host health, and the catalog listing. Never exposes filesystem paths, node addresses, storage keys, setting values or credentials.

scopes.name: admin:sessions:control
scopes.description: Pause, resume, stop, message and terminate live playback sessions.

scopes.name: admin:entitlements:bulk
scopes.description: Read authoritative account policies, discover organization policy cohorts, and run confirmed durable bulk entitlement jobs.

scopes.name: admin:entitlements:accounts
scopes.description: Read entitlement templates and preview and apply a template to one account. Cannot create or change templates.

scopes.name: admin:preview
scopes.description: Configure the read-only preview, its launch keys and curated catalog. Requires a Platform administrator.
